import tempfile,unittest
from pathlib import Path
scratch=Path('.test-tmp'); scratch.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='page-text-',dir=scratch) as temporary:
 tempfile.tempdir=str(Path(temporary).resolve())
 suite=unittest.TestSuite()
 for pattern in ('test_fulfillment_pages.py','test_project_pages.py','test_state_consistency_pages.py','test_text_transform.py'):
  suite.addTests(unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests',pattern=pattern))
 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1).run(suite)
 raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
